t: A palm-sized Linux AI camera you program with drag and drop blocks.
steps: Buy a reCamera 2002 or 2002w from Seeed Studio for about 92 US dollars or more.
Plug it into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open the reCamera web dashboard in your browser.
Watch the preinstalled YOLO11 model label objects in the live view.
Open the Node-RED editor from the dashboard.
Try a ready flow from the Seeed Node-RED flows guide.
Add an MQTT or web output to send detections somewhere useful.
meta: Open Board. From $83.40. A few stores.
